description: Retrieve recent interaction history formatted for LLM context. Returns chronological conversation history across all I/O interfaces (console, JSON-RPC, Telegram, etc.). Memories are global - session_id is an optional filter, not required.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Formatted conversation history with event count
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: DatabaseError: failed to query conversation events from storage.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For database errors: verify state storage is accessible and running.
